claim: Dagster models pipelines as declarative Software-Defined Assets with lineage and partition schemes, compiling executions into a deterministic ExecutionPlan composed of discrete ExecutionStep nodes.
mechanism: ExecutionPlan.build resolves upstream asset inputs, builds topological step dependency trees, attaches IO managers, and validates schema types prior to launching worker execution.
applicabilityConditions: All Dagster Job and Asset pipeline executions
localContext: ExecutionPlan.build resolves upstream asset inputs, builds topological step dependency trees, attaches IO managers, and validates schema types prior to launching worker execution. Known limits: Cycles in asset dependencies are rejected during definition time prior to plan compilation.

sourceProvenance.queryOrCodeSnippet: ExecutionPlan.build evaluates pipeline dependencies, resolves required resources, creates ExecutionStep nodes with input/output bindings, and computes the topological execution graph.

claim: Pipeline execution progress is emitted as strongly-typed DagsterEvent records (STEP_START, STEP_OUTPUT, ASSET_MATERIALIZATION, STEP_SUCCESS, STEP_FAILURE) stored in relational event log tables with secondary index validation.
mechanism: core_dagster_event_sequence_for_step yields typed events to SqlEventLogStorage.store_event, committing records transactionally and updating cached materialization tables while respecting log wipe boundaries.
applicabilityConditions: All Dagster runs across SqlEventLogStorage implementations (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite)
localContext: core_dagster_event_sequence_for_step yields typed events to SqlEventLogStorage.store_event, committing records transactionally and updating cached materialization tables while respecting log wipe boundaries. Known limits: High event volume under wide fan-outs requires database index optimization and event log sharding.

claim: Inter-step data exchange is decoupled from compute logic via IOManagers that persist intermediate outputs to durable storage, allowing failed runs to resume execution without recomputing successful steps.
mechanism: IOManager.handle_output serializes outputs to durable storage paths; IOManager.load_input loads values by asset key and partition key during downstream step execution.
applicabilityConditions: All pipeline executions with configured IOManagers (FSIOManager, S3PickleIOManager, GCSFileIOManager)
localContext: IOManager.handle_output serializes outputs to durable storage paths; IOManager.load_input loads values by asset key and partition key during downstream step execution. Known limits: Custom python objects must be picklable or supported by custom type serializers in the IOManager.

mechanism: submit_run records QUEUED status in SqlRunStorage. QueuedRunCoordinatorDaemon.run_iteration queries in-progress runs, checks concurrency tag limits, and dequeues eligible runs to invoke DefaultRunLauncher.
localContext: submit_run records QUEUED status in SqlRunStorage. Known limits: Queue dequeue latency is governed by dequeue_interval_seconds (default 0.5s) in the daemon loop.

mechanism: SqlPollingEventWatcher.close() sets should_thread_exit and empties the thread dictionary inside _dict_lock, releasing the lock before calling thread.join(), allowing re-entrant unwatch_run callbacks to complete without deadlock.
applicabilityConditions: SqlPollingEventWatcher and event stream subscription lifecycles
localContext: SqlPollingEventWatcher.close() sets should_thread_exit and empties the thread dictionary inside _dict_lock, releasing the lock before calling thread.join(), allowing re-entrant unwatch_run callbacks to complete without deadlock. claim: When a multi-step execution fails, Dagster compiles a partial re-execution plan targeting only failed or unexecuted steps, reloading upstream outputs from IOManager using KnownExecutionState.
mechanism: KnownExecutionState tracks completed step outputs from the parent run. ExecutionPlan.build prunes already-succeeded steps and generates synthetic input-loading steps to fetch persisted outputs from the IOManager.
applicabilityConditions: Pipeline re-executions (from failure, or selected sub-graphs)
localContext: KnownExecutionState tracks completed step outputs from the parent run. ExecutionPlan.build prunes already-succeeded steps and generates synthetic input-loading steps to fetch persisted outputs from the IOManager. Known limits: Requires upstream intermediate outputs to remain available in durable IOManager storage.

claim: Run failure reason tags must be written before or atomically with run status updates in SQL storage to prevent race conditions where polling readers observe a failed run with missing failure tags.
mechanism: SqlRunStorage.handle_run_event writes the RunTagsTable row containing dagster/failure_reason before committing the RunsTable status update to FAILURE and embeds the tag in the serialized run_body.
localContext: SqlRunStorage.handle_run_event writes the RunTagsTable row containing dagster/failure_reason before committing the RunsTable status update to FAILURE and embeds the tag in the serialized run_body. Known limits: Guarantees tag visibility across databases with autocommit connections (PostgreSQL).
